newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani interbank call market rates remain high.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani interbank call market rates remain high.

text.p: Pakistan's interbank call market rates remained high on Sunday owing to a shortage of funds and some banks approached the central bank's discount window for borrowing, dealers said.
Bid and offers were at 19.90 and 20 percent respectively but most deals closed at 20 percent, one dealer said.
Borrowers who could not use the central bank's discount window had to borrow at 21 or 22 percent, he said.
Interest rates were expected to stay at similar levels on Monday, the dealer said.
